lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance blobs posterior to the branchial region are arranged in a semi-regular rectilinear grid, with inter-centroid spacing increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs, forming high-luminance anchor nodes within a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal-facing slope and shadow on the ventral-facing slope.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced size-gradient of high-luminance spots, transitioning from high-density micro-spots on the cephalic region to larger, sparse blobs on the lateral flank.
